hypotheses.C4_behavior_subspace_transfers_ood: Rank-64 OOD fidelity is within 0.10 of FineWeb.
hypotheses.C5_behavior_optimization_improves_valida: At rank 64, optimization improves validation fidelity by at least 0.05 over its forward-PCA initialization.
hypotheses.C6_behavior_subspace_generalizes_from_va: At rank 64, held-out FineWeb fidelity is within 0.05 of selected validation fidelity.
hypotheses.C7_rank32_behavior_subspace_is_useful: The optimized rank-32 subspace retains at least 0.80 on every corpus.
